name: alix
description: Legend Boy — a mobile AI assistant (chat, voice, camera, files, research) powered by Google Gemini, hosted on Cloudflare Workers

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Your Google Gemini API key. Get one free at [aistudio.google.com/apikey](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey) (new keys start with `AQ.`). Saved as an encrypted **Secret**. You can also leave it empty and paste the key inside the app later.

GEMINI_MODEL.description: Gemini model for chat, photos, research and voice. `gemini-flash-latest` always uses Google's newest Flash model.

GEMINI_TTS_MODEL.description: Gemini text-to-speech model for Legend Boy's voice.

GEMINI_IMAGE_MODEL.description: Gemini image model for the Create image feature.
